title: Noon at the Zoo
lines: Meg went with her school to the zoo.
At noon Mom gave her a bag of food.
In the bag was a bun and a spoon.
A goat came up and took the whole bag!
Meg ran fast, but the goat was fast too.
It went up on the roof of the shed.
Meg made a big yell, but the goat sat.
Then Meg got a long tool from Mom.
She hooked the bag and got it back.
The food was gone, but the spoon was not.
Mom gave Meg some of her noon food.
Meg will keep her bag shut at the zoo.

questions.ask: What was in the bag of food?
questions.listenFor: A bun and a spoon. It is in the third line.

questions.ask: How did Meg get her bag back from the roof?
questions.listenFor: She got a long tool and hooked the bag. Yelling had not worked.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg was cross at the goat? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Ask what in the story makes them think so.
